subject_definitions:
<Subject 1> is Zhe, the young adult man in <Picture 1>: tousled dark blue-grey hair, cream jacket, grey T-shirt, dark-grey trousers, black-and-white sneakers.
<Subject 2> is Remi, the young adult winged woman in <Picture 2>: short pink hair, a silver star ornament, a purple-blue ribbon and cross pendant, red uniform shirt, black apron and short skirt, white feathered wings, black heels.
<Subject 3> is the café in <Picture 3>: viewed inward, window seats lie left of the entrance, the long counter lies right, and the equipment counter follows the inside right wall. The glass door is open.
<Subject 4> is the two takeaway cups from <Picture 4>: cream paper, tan sleeves and dark-brown lids, both filled with latte and capped.
<Audio 1> supplies voice timbre for <Subject 1> (S1).
<Audio 2> supplies voice timbre for <Subject 2> (S2).
Pictures guide identity, wardrobe, props and geometry rather than fixed frames or reference-sheet layouts.

summary:
[reference generation + audio reference] A 12-second, three-shot scene: <Subject 1> compliments <Subject 2>'s uniform, she thanks him, and he leaves <Subject 3> with <Subject 4>, glancing back before stepping outside. Each audio reference guides its assigned speaker.

detailed_description:
Naturalistic cinematic comedy, soft daytime window light and gentle equipment lighting. Both cups remain capped, one in each of <Subject 1>'s hands throughout.
[Shot 1] A five-second medium two-shot from the customer-side ordering area, diagonally toward the counter interior, with the right-wall equipment counter behind. <Subject 1> faces <Subject 2> at the near-entrance ordering position; she faces him from inside the counter. After a one-second hesitation, his gaze rises from her uniform to her face. Using <Audio 1> timbre, <Subject 1> (S1) says hesitantly and sincerely, <d>[Mandarin Chinese] 呃……你穿这身衣服很漂亮。</d> His expression is the focus; he finishes looking at her, awaiting a response.
At 00:05.000, cut to [Shot 2] a two-second close-up of <Subject 2> from the customer side; the equipment counter and right wall are behind her. Looking toward him, she smiles gently. Using <Audio 2> timbre, <Subject 2> (S2) replies warmly and briefly, <d>[Mandarin Chinese] 谢谢。</d> Hold her silent smile for the remaining second.
At 00:07.000, cut to [Shot 3] a five-second wide shot from the customer aisle near the counter toward the shop front, showing the open glass door, front windows and window seats. <Subject 1> turns with both cups and walks the short, four-or-five-step aisle toward the doorway. Before crossing the threshold, he glances back toward the counter, then faces forward and steps fully outside. Follow his departure with the frame's focus; footsteps accompany him while the indoor hum grows softer. End with both cups still in his hands and the glass door open.

overall_soundscape:
Quiet café equipment hum continues across cuts; footsteps become distinct during the departure.

non_diegetic_music:
None.
